name: crypt.encrypt
description: Encrypts Lua string bytes with AES CBC, ECB, or CTR using a Base64-decoded key, then returns Base64 ciphertext and the IV result.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Plaintext bytes read from a Lua string.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Base64 key decoded before it is passed to AES.

parameters.name: iv
parameters.description: Optional Base64 IV for CBC or CTR. When omitted for CBC or CTR, a new AES block-size IV is generated.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: AES mode. The AES- prefix is removed when present. Defaults to AES-CBC. CBC and ECB use crypto library DEFAULT_PADDING; CTR uses no padding.
